gloss: to accelerate; to speed up; to gain momentum

definitions.gloss: to accelerate; to speed up; to pick up speed
definitions.explanation: To increase in speed or rate of motion. Used for both physical movement and abstract processes becoming faster.

definitions.gloss: to gain momentum; to intensify; to escalate
definitions.explanation: For a trend, change, or process to become more rapid or intense over time.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}が{加速|かそく}した。
カーブを{抜|ぬ}けてから{一気|いっき}に{加速|かそく}した。
examples.english: After coming out of the curve, I accelerated all at once.

examples.japanese: ロケットは{大気圏|たいきけん}を{抜|ぬ}けるためにさらに{加速|かそく}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: The rocket needs to accelerate further to break through the atmosphere.

examples.japanese: {少子化|しょうしか}が{加速|かそく}している。
デジタル{化|か}の{流|なが}れが{加速|かそく}している。
examples.english: The trend toward digitalization is gaining momentum.

examples.japanese: {人口減少|じんこうげんしょう}によって{地方|ちほう}の{過疎化|かそか}がさらに{加速|かそく}すると{予測|よそく}されている。
examples.english: It is predicted that depopulation of rural areas will further accelerate due to population decline.

notes:
Describes both physical acceleration and the intensification of trends or processes. The physical sense is common in transportation and physics contexts, while the figurative sense frequently appears in news and social commentary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {加速度|かそくど}: acceleration (physics term)
- {加速|かそく}ペダル: accelerator pedal
- {変化|へんか}が{加速|かそく}する: change accelerates
- {成長|せいちょう}を{加速|かそく}させる: to accelerate growth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {速|はや}める: to hasten — more general, used for actions and schedules
- スピードアップする: to speed up — casual, often for work pace
- {促進|そくしん}する: to promote/facilitate — focuses on encouraging progress rather than raw speed
